reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound mechanism (grain boundary segregation of Ti) that directly addresses the room-temperature ductility limitation in a BCC refractory alloy, while maintaining high-temperature and irradiation performance within clear, testable boundaries. Hypothesis B relies on TWIP/TRIP mechanisms that are not established for BCC NbMoTaW and cites evidence from an f.c.c./h.c.p. system, making its mechanism less plausible and its contribution less substantive for this specific material.
